post.description: Paginated UDI search. At least one `filter` key is required; an empty filter fails with HTTP 500 and `mensagem: mensagens.MSG-062`. Verified live: `nomeComercial` (substring), `udiDi` (exact), `cnpjDetentora`, `codigoGmdn`, `nuRegistro`; the other keys come from the published example and are untested. The filter check runs before the page check: `page: 0` with an empty filter still yields MSG-062, not the page-index error.

500.description: Internal error OR request validation failure (see ErroApi.mensagem / mensagem_detalhada).

post.description: Paginated GMDN term search; names and definitions are in Portuguese. Works with an empty `filter`. Verified live: `conteudo` (text); `codigo` from ANVISA's example is untested.

500.description: Internal error OR request validation failure (see ErroApi.mensagem / mensagem_detalhada).

sorting.description: Map of column name to ASC/DESC. Sending an array is rejected with a Jackson deserialization error.

page.description: 1-based page number. page=0 fails with "Page index must not be less than zero!". Responses are Spring Page objects and report the page 0-based in `number` / `pageable.pageNumber`.

filter.description: Map of filter key to value. Required keys depend on the endpoint; see each operation's `x-required-filters`.

ErroApi.description: Envelope returned with HTTP 500 for both internal errors and request validation failures (missing required filter, page < 1, malformed body).

mensagem.description: Human message, or an unresolved i18n key such as `mensagens.MSG-062` (= at least one filter is required).

data_hora.description: Server-local timestamp as [year, month, day, hour, minute, second, nanosecond].

mensagem_detalhada.description: Detail text, e.g. "Filtro 'subfila' não informado." or a Java stack message.

Keycloak.description: Keycloak OAuth2 client credentials (realm `externo`). The access token expires in 1740 s (the portal's token tutorial says 300; the live value is 1740) and no refresh token is issued; request a new token with the same credentials. The JWT carries `aud: [consultas-externas-service, account]` and the single role `CONSULTASEXTERNAS_LEITURA`; there are no per-endpoint scopes.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Tokens left in the bucket after this request (shared per source address).

x-anvisa-client-requirements.userAgent: Required. Cloudflare answers HTTP 403 (HTML "Attention Required") to curl's default User-Agent, even for this spec document. Send a descriptive User-Agent.

rateLimit.type: token bucket (Spring Cloud Gateway). Observed 2026-09-06 to be shared between the authenticated API and the unauthenticated portal backend on the same gateway, i.e. keyed by source address rather than by client_id.

x-anvisa-client-requirements.dates: All date-time fields are sent as integer epoch milliseconds.
x-anvisa-client-requirements.errors: Request validation failures are returned as HTTP 500 with the `ErroApi` envelope, not as 400.
